dataset.title: Extracellular vesicles in Early preterm neonates and thrombin generation
dataset.study_design: human plasma extracellular-vesicle proteomics; 20 preterm and 10 term neonatal units in the deposited proteomics subset

source_scope.unit_definition: sample-native patient/timepoint label; two source technical replicate columns are not counted as independent units
source_scope.source_data_boundary: MaxQuant proteinGroups.txt LFQ intensity columns; no imputation and no cross-study abundance-scale use

quantification_contract.rank_eligibility: strictly positive finite LFQ value; technical replicates remain separate in the audit map
quantification_contract.batch_level_target_observation: unique canonical target with at least one positive technical replicate in a patient/timepoint batch
quantification_contract.technical_replicate_policy: replicate columns are preserved and may be aggregated only by a separately frozen sensitivity protocol

claim_boundary: This receipt verifies a CC0 PXD064962 MaxQuant table, its row/column hashes, 30 patient/timepoint batches, 21 frozen-target accessions and 1,260 traceable target cells. Only five batches meet the frozen >=10-target coverage rule, so this source is not admitted to the primary OOD endpoint and cannot establish independent validation, lockbox evaluation, no-author reproduction, adoption or scientific submission readiness.
